description:
The image depicts a large gray wheelbarrow filled with apples and grass, situated on a wooden deck in front of a yard. The wheelbarrow is positioned at an angle, with its handle extending beyond the right side of the frame. It is overflowing with a variety of small, red, green, and brown apples, some of which appear to be rotting, and scattered green grass. The deck beneath the wheelbarrow is constructed from dark wooden planks.
